All certificate templates have a photo box: the 3 STCW (Safety, Crowd, Crisis) and all 141 In-House. The Releasing Officer clicks Upload Photo; it is cropped square, resized and placed inside the box automatically, on Preview Draft and on Print.

The portal fills: the name, training date(s), the assessment date (last training day), Date of Issue (print day), Certificate No., Registration No., and the 2x2 photo in the box. No QR is added.

Preview Draft

Try it: click Upload Photo on any row and pick a photo from your computer. It stays on this page only; nothing is sent anywhere.

Every row has Preview Draft, whatever the stage, to double-check. A draft is marked "DRAFT – NOT FOR RELEASE", never counts as a print and never uses up a Certificate No.
